'''Sol Vara''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]<ref name="Duros" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]].<ref name="Datacron">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 58: Ulic's Trials}}</ref> Vara became famous when the smuggler outran the forces of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] to bring supplies to the refugees on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aduba-6]].<ref name="Duros" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sol Vara was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Duros [[Species/Legends|species]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. However, the Duros entry, along with many of the entries that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], were removed before the game's final release in [[2011]].<ref name="Duros" />
